name: Underground-cable outgoing bay arrangement
summary: Groups switching and measurement interfaces serving the assigned cable circuit.
description: Groups switching and measurement interfaces serving the assigned cable circuit. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Switchyard bus” at the input and “Cable circuit termination” at the output. Cable sheath and earthing interfaces need separate detail.
